one_liner: Cloud-hosted database-as-a-service supporting MongoDB clusters with a robust Administration API.
auth_notes: Supports Service Accounts using OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow or API Keys with HTTP Digest Authentication.
gate_notes: Free tier available; self-serve signup provides access to Atlas administration API keys and service accounts.
verdict_reason: MongoDB Atlas offers a well-documented Administration API with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2.0 service accounts, making it fully ready for an API toolkit integration.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits apply per project/organization based on Atlas tier.

evidence.quote: Learn how to authenticate Atlas Administration API requests using Service Accounts with OAuth 2.0 or API Keys with HTTP Digest Authentication to manage
